description: Establish an offline test baseline so the pure logic in bot.py can be verified without network access (sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY and cannot reach architecture.snu.ac.kr / Slack / Notion). Create a virtualenv, install deps, confirm bot.py compiles, and add a tests/ scaffold with tests for the existing pure functions. This baseline is what later features (which add failure-notification, heartbeat, and state changes) will extend.
steps: cd /projects/sandbox/daaetest and create a venv: `python3 -m venv .venv` then `. .venv/bin/activate` and `pip install -r requirements.txt`.

Try `pip install pytest`. If the registry is blocked by INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, fall back to Python's built-in unittest (no install needed) and write tests as unittest.TestCase classes runnable via `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
Create tests/ directory with tests/test_bot.py (and tests/__init__.py if using unittest discover).

Write tests for existing pure functions: normalize_notice (feed a sample getNotices item dict {id,title,category,ctype,post_date} and assert normalized keys id/title/link/post_date/ctype, including link = base_url + '/post/{id}'); _format_post_date ('2026.06.08' -> '2026. 6. 8.', and passthrough for unparseable input); _clean_text (strips HTML tags and unescapes entities); _slack_escape (escapes &,<,> and replaces | ); build_slack_summary_text (returns header with count and one line per post); build_slack_attachments (returns list with one dict having color '#003876' and a 'blocks' list); load_state/save_state round-trip using a tmp path.
Run the tests and confirm they pass.
acceptance_criteria: A tests/ directory exists with at least one test module.
Running the test suite (pytest OR `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`) passes with all tests green.
Tests exercise real bot.py functions (import from bot), not reimplementations.
verification: python3 -m pytest tests/ -v  (or `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` if pytest unavailable) and confirm all tests pass
findings: Offline test baseline established. pip install from registries is BLOCKED in this sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: proxy returns 403 for pypi), so requests/python-dotenv/notion-client cannot be installed and pytest is unavailable. Used Python's built-in unittest instead. Because bot.py imports requests/urllib3.adapters/dotenv at module top level, importing it directly fails offline; added tests/_stubs.py which registers minimal stand-in modules in sys.modules BEFORE importing bot (falls back to real packages when installed, e.g. CI on 3.11). This lets tests import the REAL pure functions from bot.py (no reimplementation). Created tests/__init__.py, tests/_stubs.py, tests/test_bot.py. 26 tests covering normalize_notice, _format_post_date, _clean_text, _slack_escape, _parse_bool, build_slack_summary_text, build_slack_attachments (color #003876 + blocks), build_ping_attachments (#2eb67d), load_state/save_state round-trip, make_stream_key, _prune_seen_ids. Verified: `python3 -m py_compile bot.py` exits 0; `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` -> 26 passed on host Python 3.9.25. bot.py logic and workflows were NOT modified (later features do that). NOTE for later features: the venv at .venv has NO deps installed (registry blocked), so any test importing bot must go through the tests/_stubs shim; extend install_stub_dependencies() if new third-party imports are added to bot.py.
